scripts.test:install: env LD_LIBRARY_PATH='' bash bin/install-wp-tests.sh janwpb_tests $(wp config get DB_USER) $(wp config get DB_PASSWORD) $(wp config get DB_HOST) latest
scripts.update-translations: wp i18n make-pot ./ && wp i18n update-po ./languages/janw-plugin-base.pot && wp i18n make-mo ./languages/

scripts-descriptions.phpcbf: Run phpcbf autoformatter on all files via ci.sh.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: Run phpcs on all files via ci.sh.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Run phpstan on all files via ci.sh.
scripts-descriptions.phprector: Run rector on all files via ci.sh.
scripts-descriptions.setup: Rename the boilerplate for a new project. `composer setup -- --name "My Plugin" --slug my-plugin --namespace "Acme\My"`
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the fast PHPUnit unit suite (no WordPress, no database).
scripts-descriptions.test:wp: Run the WordPress integration suite (needs test:install first).
scripts-descriptions.test:install: Install the WordPress test library using the local site's DB credentials.
scripts-descriptions.ci: Run all syntax checkers on all files via ci.sh.
scripts-descriptions.ci:changed: Run all syntax checkers on changed files only via ci.sh.
scripts-descriptions.createzip: Will create a zip named 'plugin-slug.zip' in the plugin folder.
scripts-descriptions.createzip:downloads: Will create a zip named 'plugin-slug-0.1.0.zip' in the plugin folder.
scripts-descriptions.bumpversion: Run CI, then update plugin to a custom version. `composer bumpversion -- 0.10.0`
scripts-descriptions.bumpversion:major: Run CI, then update major version number.
scripts-descriptions.bumpversion:minor: Run CI, then update minor version number.
scripts-descriptions.bumpversion:patch: Run CI, then update patch version number.
scripts-descriptions.publish-version: Commit the new version, tag it and push it.
